description: Headlines that touch ONE asset in the window (press wires, corporate releases, halts, hacks, media), each with source tier, corroboration count, a −1..1 heuristic sentiment score and the asset's impact direction, plus an average sentiment label. Links to the original items; no article bodies. Use it to answer "what is the news flow on X today" or to feed a sentiment gate. $0.002/call.

ticker.description: Asset id, e.g. NVDA, BTC, MSTR. Call `universe` to list ids.

name: news_for
title: News for asset
